name: Vivechak (विवेचक)
tagline: Evidence-grounded epistemic meta-framework for technical decisions across all lifecycle stages.
description: Vivechak is an autonomous Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that forces AI agents to provide evidence grades (A–E), qualified provenance, and structured falsification for architectural decisions (ADRs), 2-to-5 option comparisons, and full project DAG pipelines.
